review_1.source: agent://OmpPortReview, review of 9f5e948b against 7fb6dc47, verdict: incorrect, no P0 or P1

F1.finding: catalog checks ran after the grant or admission lapsed
F1.resolution: CatalogPort rechecks Grant::recheck (both tuples, identity, admission expiry) and a persisted cancellation before every check, leaving it unrun and unknown, and caps each check's deadline at the admission's remaining whole seconds

F2.finding: each step's OMP base was read from the live workspace
F2.resolution: OmpPort keeps an expected base, the admitted base and then the tree each exited step left, and passes it as profile.base_identity, so the launcher blocks a workspace changed between steps

F3.finding: the never-checked deadline claim was false under an admission cap
F3.resolution: step::operator::is_capped; a deadline stop of a capped worker is unknown (deadline_capped in the step record); docs corrected

F4.finding: the killed-worker test asserted a status bubblewrap cannot produce; infrastructure check failures counted as the entry's class
F4.resolution: the fake reports a killed child as 128 + N like bubblewrap and the test asserts an observed exit 137; check statuses 126 and above are unknown; documented that a bubblewrap setup failure (exit 1) cannot be told apart

F5.finding: nested read or write paths missing from the copy made every check unknown
F5.resolution: checks mount only the request's read paths present in the copy

F6.finding: pinned checks still resolve host tools
F6.resolution: docs narrowed to 'pins the entry executable's bytes' with the reason (the shared candidate-worker sandbox mounts the host's read-only system paths and changing candidate_worker::Request would re-key Octet's baseline), and the executor route string now names host-system-ro-mounts

F7.resolution: every repair step gets repair text; no_candidate is phrased 'the previous step produced no new candidate'; other failed classes kept

notes.1: one profile evaluation per admission and per recheck (standalone::check_subjects)
notes.2: raw events are written from the owned RunResult without a copy
notes.5: the policy match runs before executables are hashed
notes.6: the catalog is opened with O_NOFOLLOW|O_NONBLOCK and must be a bounded regular file by fstat
notes.7: Launch, PinnedOmp, Standalone, checks::Execute and Sandboxed are pub(crate); operator::admit takes the policy, so the unreachable missing-policy refusal is gone
notes.8: stale docs fixed in candidate-worker.md, worker-inventory.md, Grant::recheck and Authority::EffectAuthority
notes.9: Kiln e77b8e6a (read-only clone) has no reader of repair-observation causes or authority_withdrawn; effect_authority is additive and the observation schema stays v2
notes.10: the breaking run_command(args, config) change is under CHANGELOG ### Changed
notes.11: checks poll the persisted cancellation request like the worker; SIGINT and SIGTERM still end the operator controller as a lost controller, documented, because the loop runs synchronously on the calling task
notes.12: documented that a configuration, catalog or profile error closes the attempt-fence

review_2.source: verification of 6b99af1e: correct, F1 and F2 closed, no regressions; two P3 items and three notes

authority_lapse_before_checks.resolution: the driver's check phase (cli/repair/steps/checks.rs) rechecks the operator grant once before a revision's checks through Driver::recheck_operator; a lapse ends the loop authority_withdrawn (effect_authority) with the recheck evidence and runs no check; the per-check recheck still leaves a check unrun and unknown when the grant lapses between checks

cancel_during_checks.resolution: a persisted cancellation request found when the check phase ends stops the loop as cancelled; inventory reports it terminal and export refuses it as repair_not_candidate
